builds.title: Centaur trail envoy, 4 racial HD
traits: Neutral good. BAB +4, grapple +13. Fort +4, Ref +7, Will +6. Touch 12, flat-footed 12.

Natural armor +3, Dexterity +3, Large size −1 to AC and attacks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft., or 10 ft. with the lance against distant targets. Feats are Martial Weapon Proficiency (lance) and Weapon Focus (longbow), which also covers composite longbows.
Racial ranks, Listen 4, Move Silently 3, Spot 4, Survival 3.
actions: Large composite longbow (+5 Str rating) +7 ranged, 2d6+5 piercing, critical ×3, 110-ft. range increment.
Large lance +8 melee, 2d6+7 piercing wielded two-handed, critical ×3. A legal charge raises the attack to +10, deals 4d6+14 on an ordinary hit, and costs 2 AC until the next turn.
In a full attack, add two secondary hooves at +3 for 1d6+2 bludgeoning each against targets in natural reach.
builds.tactics: Myrine uses the bow while the families open a clear path. She lowers her lance only if there is room for a straight charge.

builds.title: Hound Archon road warden, 6 racial HD
traits: Lawful good. BAB +6, grapple +10. Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +7, all +4 against poison. Touch 11, flat-footed 19. Unarmored with natural armor +9 and Dexterity +1.
DR 10/evil, SR 16, immune to electricity and petrification. His constant CL 6 magic circle against evil gives its situational protection, outside the listed base AC and saves.

Aura of menace activates in a fight or when angry. Hostiles within 20 ft. save at Will DC 17 or take −2 to attacks, AC, and saves for 24 hours or until they hit him. A successful save or a hit that ends it prevents repeat exposure for 24 hours.
Nine racial ranks in each listed skill. Improved Initiative, Power Attack, and Track. Creatures with a language can speak with him through tongues.
actions: Bite +10 melee, 1d8+4 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning. In a full attack add a secondary slam +5 for 1d4+2 bludgeoning. Greatsword +10/+5 on a full attack, 2d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2.
Use a canine form to follow a trail. Hide and Survival each gain +4 circumstance in canine form, before adjusting for the form's other statistics. The form supplies its own bite.
At will CL 6 aid, continual flame, detect evil, and message. Aid grants +1 morale to attacks and fear saves plus 1d8+6 temporary HP for 6 minutes.
Greater teleport at will, CL 14, carrying only himself and up to 50 lb. of objects.
builds.tactics: Brindle takes canine form to pick up a trail, then speaks to the group before closing. He opens with aid on the ally who has to hold the ford.

builds.title: Janni elemental surveyor, 6 racial HD
traits: Neutral. BAB +6, grapple +10. Fort +7, Ref +8, Will +8. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. Unarmored with natural armor +1 and Dexterity +3.
Fire resistance 10. She can stay on an Elemental Plane for 48 hours before taking 1 damage per additional hour. She checks the elapsed time before offering another crossing.
Nine racial ranks in each listed skill. Dodge, Mobility, Weapon Focus (scimitar), and racial Improved Initiative.
actions: Scimitar +11 melee, 1d6+4 slashing, critical 18–20/×2. Iterative attack at +6 on a full attack.
Change size 2/day, Fort DC 14 if resisted, as enlarge person or reduce person and can affect Nura despite her type.
Invisibility (self only) and speak with animals 3/day each, CL 12. Ethereal jaunt 1/day for 1 hour, CL 12. Create food and water 1/day, CL 7.
Plane shift at CL 13 to the Material, Astral, or Elemental Planes. Nura can bring up to eight other creatures who link hands with her.
builds.tactics: Nura changes size to clear a tight route or uses invisibility to approach a stranded crew. She saves plane shift for the return when everyone can link hands.

builds.title: Lizardfolk channel warden, 2 racial HD
traits: Neutral. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Dexterity +1 and natural armor +5, with no shield.
Racial ranks are Balance 4, Jump 3, Swim 3. Each check has the +4 racial bonus. Hold breath up to 64 rounds before drowning checks. Weapon Focus (claw).
actions: Claw +5 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing. A full attack adds a second claw at the same bonus and a secondary bite at −1 for 1d4+1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning.
Use Swim +10 to reach and release the ferry line. On a successful full-round Swim check, Vesh can go up to 15 ft.
builds.tactics: Vesh keeps both hands available for the rope and enters the water before the ferry pulls taut.

builds.title: Pixie screen courier, Sorcerer 1
traits: Neutral good. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +4. Touch 15, flat-footed 12. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +4, Small size +1. Dodge gives +1 AC against a designated foe.
DR 10/cold iron and SR 16. Constant greater invisibility, including while attacking. Suppress or resume it as a free action.

Improved Initiative, racial Dodge and Weapon Finesse. Ranks are 4 each in Bluff, Concentration, Knowledge (arcana), and Spellcraft, with 2 cross-class ranks in Hide. No familiar is present in this encounter.
actions: Small longbow +5 ranged with ordinary arrows, 1d6−1 piercing (minimum 1), critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment.

Racial SLAs at CL 8, each 1/day. Lesser confusion DC 15, dancing lights, all four alignment detects, detect thoughts DC 16, dispel magic, entangle DC 15, and permanent image DC 20 for visual and auditory effects only.

Sorcerer CL 1, five cantrip and four 1st-level castings per day. Known cantrips are detect magic, ghost sound (DC 14), mage hand, and prestidigitation. First-level spells known are mage armor (+4 armor AC for 1 hour) and obscuring mist (1 minute).
builds.tactics: Bren waits above the path, uses an image or sound to draw attention, and crosses while the patrol is watching the decoy.

concepts.name: Myrine Ashrein
concepts.motive: Get the families across the open road before the storm reaches them.
concepts.hook: Myrine offers to draw attention down the broad trail while the party escorts the wagons.

concepts.name: Brother Brindle
concepts.motive: Find the missing travelers before night closes over the ford.
concepts.hook: A hound follows the party to the milepost and then stands upright to ask whom they are looking for.

concepts.name: Nura bint Sahl
concepts.motive: Recover the apprentices stranded on the Plane of Air before their guide's endurance expires.
concepts.hook: Nura can take the party across if everyone keeps the chain of hands intact.

concepts.name: Vesh Reedcurrent
concepts.role: Channel warden and submerged rescue guide.
concepts.motive: Free the snagged ferry rope before the pull of the current tears out the bracket.
concepts.hook: Vesh offers to reach the rope from underwater while someone watches the ferry's drift.

concepts.name: Bren Hazelwing
concepts.motive: Move the summons across the valley without sending the patrol after its bearer.
concepts.hook: Bren reveals blue thread tied to a gate latch and asks the party to follow it after the patrol passes.
